x: Brian Hallowell won the 880 yards with George Davidson 3rd. We had only one runner in the mile, Steve Boreham, who did his fastest time in finishing 3rd.

Jim Heathfiekd won the 880 yards in 2mins. 1.6s. using tactics that paid a good dividend. Steve Boreham ran well in the mile as also did Shippen. This lad can be a good prospect with another winter over the country.
Our visitors provided the winner of the 880 yds, Steve Boreham being a good second in 2m.3.2s.; he was just unable to get on terms with the winner despite his characteristic final burst.
Simultaneously I saw Steve Boreham sink entirely and as he came up (I didn't think he could swim) I grabbed him as he was being carried away and just dumped him clear of the water on the other side.
